# GENMA Solutions

> > International leader in material lifting and handling solutions for shipyards, ports, and industrial facilities with global manufacturing and service networks.

GENMA Solutions specializes in designing, manufacturing, and servicing advanced lifting and material handling equipment for maritime, industrial, and port applications. With manufacturing bases in Jiangsu and Nantong, China, the company provides comprehensive after-sales support through a global service network.

## Key Topics

- Material handling solutions
- Lifting equipment
- Offshore engineering
- Container terminal cranes
- Bulk material handling
- Port equipment
- Industrial cranes
- RTG/RMG gantry cranes
- Mobile harbor cranes
- MHH (Multi-functional High-efficiency Material Handler)
- Manufacturing facilities
- Global service network
- Heavy equipment
- Cargo handling
- Customer support

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Shipyard/Material Yard/Workshop Lifting Solutions](https://www.genmasolutions.com/shop/shipyard-material-yard-workshop-lifting-solution): Overhead, portal, and gantry cranes for shipyards and industrial workshops
- [Marine and Offshore Engineering Lifting Solutions](https://www.genmasolutions.com/shop/marine-and-offshore-engineering-lifting-solution): Specialized offshore cranes including flagpole, pedestal, floating, and wound pile types
- [Bulk Material Handling Solutions](https://www.genmasolutions.com/shop/bulk-material-handling-solutions): Ship loaders, unloaders, and mobile harbor cranes for bulk cargo operations
- [Terminal Container Cranes](https://www.genmasolutions.com/shop/terminal-container-cranes): RTG and RMG gantry crane solutions for container terminal operations
- [Multi-functional High-efficiency Material Handler (MHH)](https://www.genmasolutions.com/shop/multi-functional-high-efficiency-material-handlermhh): Advanced MHH product for versatile material handling applications
